title: Remove discontinued stock
prompt: Some warehouses are stopping some SKUs. `discontinued()` lists the warehouse and SKU of each one. Write `remove(stopped, path)` so it deletes exactly those rows from the Delta stock table with a merge.
rules: A stock row is one SKU in one warehouse: delete a row only when both its `warehouse_id` and `sku` are in the list.
The same SKU in other warehouses stays. A listed pair the table doesn't hold changes nothing; nothing is added.
Every other row stays as it is. Don't change `start_table`, `discontinued` or `solve`.
hints: Start from `DeltaTable.forPath(spark, path).alias("t")` and merge in the list as `s`.
The condition must cover the whole key: both columns, joined with `AND`.
`whenMatchedDelete()` removes the table rows a source row matches. Leave out the insert clause, then call `execute()`.
explanation: A merge with only a delete clause does it: `table.alias("t").merge(stopped.alias("s"), "t.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND t.sku = s.sku").whenMatchedDelete().execute()`. Matching on `sku` alone deletes packing tape from every warehouse, not just `WH01`. With no `whenNotMatched` clause, a listed pair the table doesn't hold is simply ignored. One source row may match several table rows, so a row listed twice in the table goes with both copies. A missing warehouse never equals anything, so that row stays.
